added.prompt: A company proposes replacing every staff laptop after two years and moving all files to cloud storage. Evaluate the environmental effects of this plan, including manufacture, energy use and disposal. Recommend ways to reduce harm without assuming that cloud storage is automatically greener.

A school introduces a mobile app for homework and messages. It collects pupil location continuously and can only be used on a recent smartphone. Discuss benefits and concerns, then recommend changes that retain the useful features.

A pupil discovers that a school's system appears poorly protected. They access another pupil's files to demonstrate the weakness, claiming that helping the school makes this acceptable. Discuss the ethical and legal issues and a more responsible response.

A connected medical implant sends readings to a clinic. Evaluate the benefits and the ethical risks of this connection, including reliability, unauthorised access and privacy. Give a balanced conclusion.

An employer proposes giving staff fitness watches to support a wellbeing scheme. Participation is described as optional, but managers want to use individual activity and location records when considering promotion. Evaluate this proposal, considering benefits, privacy, fairness and responsible handling of the information. Recommend a justified approach.
